chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ismail ibn Mihran, from Sayf ibn 'Umeyra, from Bashir al-Nabbal, from Humran ibn A'yan, who said:
I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him): 'The people say that the earth is folded for us at night; how is it folded?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Like this,' then he folded his garment.
ai.seo_question: How did Imam al-Sadiq explain the folding of the earth for believers at night?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Humran ibn A'yan queries Imam al-Sadiq (AS) regarding the eschatological concept of the earth being 'folded' for the faithful, to which the Imam responds with a physical gesture of folding his garment. This narration is significant in Shia scholarship for illustrating the *ta'wil* (interpretation) of the 'folding' as a miraculous facilitation of travel or spatial compression, rather than a literal physical folding of the planet's crust. It underscores the Imam's role in elucidating metaphysical realities through simple, tangible demonstrations.

en.hubeali: H 14938 – A number of our companions, Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ismail Bin Mahraan, from Sayf Bin Umeyra, from Basheer Al-Nabaal, from Humraan Bin Ayn who said:
I said to Abu Ja’farasws, ‘The people are saying the earth would fold up for us at night, how it would fold up?’ Heasws said: ‘Like this’, then folded hisasws cloth’.
en.sarwar: 491. Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammaad Bin Usman, who has narrated the following:
Abu Abdullah (a.s.) has said: ‘The earth folds up during the end of the night’.
